title.en: Experienced trainer with deep breed knowledge

text.en: Clients express immense gratitude for head trainer Prentice Kidd, praising his confident handling and thorough understanding of canine psychology. Owners note that he works effectively with large working breeds, imparting practical tools without resorting to anger or aggressive corrections.

Pet parents highlight remarkable transformations in dogs previously considered dangerous or unmanageable. Multiple reviews describe dogs stopping aggressive biting, ending leash lunging, and remaining completely calm during public obedience sessions in busy retail stores.

Reviewers emphasize how training helps powerful breeds, including Boerboels, Rottweilers, and German Shepherds, become trustworthy companions. Clients report that their dogs return from training and boarding well-mannered, happy, and capable of coexisting peacefully with families.

q.en: Does the trainer work with aggressive or reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically credit Prentice Kidd with successfully rehabilitating dogs exhibiting severe aggression and bite histories.

q.en: Does training include real-world public sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients describe practicing obedience commands in public settings, such as retail stores, to build focus around real distractions.

q.en: Are boarding and board-and-train programs available?

a.en: Yes, pet parents mention boarding their dogs with the trainer for multi-day immersion and training reinforcement.
